skills.belief: Use normal preplant checks, field prep, 1.1 m ridges, and HEINONG84 standard-density planting.
skills.action_pattern: prep, base fertilizer, ridging, plant in 4-ridge blocks at depth 4.0 cm and seed spacing 7.9 cm, commit and recheck

skills.belief: Wet June disease pressure should be treated only after disease evidence and a suitable spray/trafficability window are confirmed.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck short spray window, load fungicide, apply targeted fungicide blocks, recheck disease state
constraints: do not spray from NDVI alone
do not treat insects/weeds/water/nutrients with fungicide

skills.belief: Wait/recheck from R8 until moisture/weather/trafficability/capacity support harvest; dry before storage if moisture requires it.
skills.action_pattern: harvest in 4-ridge blocks, unload, dry_grain(target_moisture_pct=13.0), store, recheck inventory
constraints: do not store wet grain directly
